answer: Require each identity to post a small refundable bond that is slashed if peers catch duplicated or plagiarized work. Like boats tied to one jetty, sybils share infrastructure and behavior, so their answers echo each other; detecting one exposes the cluster and burns every bond in it. Honest agents risk one bond, but an attacker must fund a spiral of separate bonds for each fake, making scale cost more than the rewards it can extract.
